title: chore: release v0.6.1 (patch)
body:
Patch release bumping all packages from `0.6.0` to `0.6.1` for maintenance and stability improvements.

## Changes

- Bumped 11 core packages to `0.6.1`:
  - `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/client`, `@objectstack/driver-memory`
  - `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`, `@objectstack/plugin-msw`
  - `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/types`, `@objectstack/ai-bridge`
  - `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/core`
- Updated peer dependencies in plugins (e.g., `@objectstack/runtime: ^0.6.0` → `^0.6.1`)
- Generated CHANGELOGs across monorepo
- Updated root package and main CHANGELOG

## Publishing

Ready to publish via `pnpm run release` once merged.
